Weekly tips for returning guests
Someone on the desk wanted you to know
Travel with your companion animal stays smooth when you send in details early and keep your papers ready.

Animal travel checks need steady attention, so please review every form before you head to the airport. A small mismatch can slow the handover, and that delay affects your whole trip. If your carrier, feeding notes, or calm-item request has changed, tell the Companion Animal Travel Desk right away so we can keep the file clean and the plan simple.

Our team handles a lot of routine work, but the order matters. Safety takes priority over speed in every journey. Passengers receive clear guidance before departure. The company expects prompt, respectful communication. That means replying quickly, using plain language, and sending updates as soon as anything changes with your pet or booking. If you are traveling with Mabel or another companion animal, please keep your documents close and your contact details easy to confirm.

Travel days move faster when travelers and staff stay calm and organized. If you are unsure about a crate, a comfort item, or a handoff step, bring the concern to us before you reach the gate. We would rather fix a small issue early than deal with a bigger one later.

For help with any companion animal travel detail, contact the Companion Animal Travel Desk.
